🎭 Two big crowds in London this summer. Look at the two headlines.

👉 Notting Hill Carnival: around 2 MILLION people, 7,000+ police officers, 240+ arrests on the FIRST DAY alone — drugs, weapons, sexual offences, multiple stabbings, and 55 arrests for assaulting police officers.
The coverage? "Mood overwhelmingly positive." A triumph.

👉 A political march last September: 100,000+ people, around 25 arrests, majority entirely peaceful.
The coverage? "Far-right." Every bulletin. Every front page.

Here's the thing — MOST people at BOTH were law-abiding. So apply ONE standard. If you judge one crowd by its worst few, judge both that way. If you treat one as a peaceful majority with a handful of bad actors, treat both that way.

Instead: greater disorder, more arrests, actual stabbings = "overwhelmingly positive". A majority-peaceful patriotic march = a menace to the nation.

Reform UK: one standard, for everyone. Report the crime honestly wherever it happens. Back our police at every event. And drop the selective "far-right" branding.

Read the full piece 👇

#OneRule #DoubleStandards #ReformUK
